author: Bobby Grayson
description: fallthrough/5 filter adds c.kind == cl.kind; when nothing matches and ctx.effects and the clause is cast/call the guard-failure result is '(state, [.exit .error])' (FunctionClauseError), otherwise the old warning 'guard has no fallthrough; Elixir would crash, modelled as no-op' remains for info clauses and message mode. render_clauses/2's subsumption check now fails with 'a <kind> clause of <mod> is shadowed by a bare <kind> pattern; use a tag' when the shadowing clause is of a different kind. main/1 destructures {out, ctx} = render(ctx, clauses) and prints ctx.warnings to stderr; before this the warnings list from render_clauses was discarded. No existing source hits any of these paths, so the five Gen files are unchanged.
title: Two correctness changes riding on the new ordering: fallthrough/5 only searches same-kind clauses (a failed handle_cast guard no longer falls into a handle_info catch-all) and a bare cast/call pattern shadowing an info clause is now fail(...) instead of silently dropping it; also render/2 previously dropped ctx so warnings were never printed, now returns {string, ctx}
